## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what changes for the user.

## Validation

List commands and results. For live tests, include the Fusion version and a sanitized summary, or state that live validation was not performed.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Relevant offline tests pass.
- [ ] Document targeting, shared-component behavior, and recovery semantics were considered.
- [ ] Documentation and validation status match the implemented behavior.
- [ ] No local configuration, credentials, journals, or private design data are included.
